title: Reverie
subtitle: A little world, opening to yours.
detail: Celestial koi circle a golden moon in a sculpted paper landscape. Two curved halves drift apart to reveal your desktop, then reunite as the lid closes.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: Neon Coast
subtitle: Your desktop, after hours.
detail: An illustrated coastal city at sunset. Angled panels part with cyan and pink edge light, opening onto your desktop.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: Rise
subtitle: Make it happen.
detail: Cobalt steps, a rising sun, and a bold reminder to get moving. A bright, sculpted split opens with an energetic sweep. Your next chapter starts here.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: Tab Goblin
subtitle: Bro. Close a tab.
detail: Your Mac has seen your browser habits. A weary little laptop, a mountain of tabs, and one reasonable request. The comic splits cleanly in two as you open the lid.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: FCUK It. Ship It.
subtitle: Less overthinking. More shipping.
detail: An unapologetic orange-and-cobalt print with a smug laptop riding a cursor rocket. FCUK IT. SHIP IT. Angled panels pull the poster apart with a burst of attitude.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: Codex After Dark
subtitle: One more fix.
detail: A determined little robot, an oversized wrench, and one very evasive bug. Codex's midnight workshop glows in cyan and lime as the pixel-art scene parts in two.
author: UnfoldMyMac

title: Claude Has Notes
subtitle: Just one small change.
detail: Claude has a few notes. And a few more. A calm paper creature, an amused laptop, and a spectacular mountain of revisions drift apart in a warm, sculpted paper reveal.
author: UnfoldMyMac
